com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote

Enum Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE>
      • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE>
    Enclosing class:
    Status

    public static enum Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE
extends java.lang.Enum<Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE>
    This enum is used with the index 2 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[2] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set. For eg : to check if the ROSINVALIDATETRADE is set try: if((statusMap[2] & Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE.ROSINVALIDATETRADE.getValue()) == Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE.ROSINVALIDATETRADE.getValue()) System.out.println(Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE.ROSINVALIDATETRADE.toString()+ "is set ");
    Since:
    01-010-0000
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
